arithmetic: For all 36 lower-modulus F-box misses with exact Omega_1<=9, enumerate the complete minimum shell; verify that the product of the two oriented rational first-denominator defects is prod(q_i^overflow_i); and compare every minimum overflow pattern with optimistic complete-source block, label-difference, modulus-difference, and reduced-endpoint q-adic heights.
scope_note: A state with no feasible minimum pattern is a finite counterexample to a coordinatewise injective local charge into the listed height levels. It does not rule out a nonlocal cross-state matching, reuse controlled by a separate theorem, a non-minimum target vector, factor splitting, or an arithmetic descent. The six states with Omega_1>=10 are outside this exact-shell audit.
